label: Instance costs
description: Read what one instance's runs cost, per priced call with whose credential paid, plus the total and how many calls had no measurable price; narrow by run, service, node, payer, or start time. Weft only reports; billing is up to the program.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: run
inputs.description: Only this run's costs, by the id GetRunId gave it.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: Only costs this node booked, named as the program writes it.

inputs.name: paidBy
inputs.description: `platform` (the runtime's credit), `author` (the program author's connection) or `instance` (the instance's own connection).

inputs.name: since
inputs.description: Only costs booked at or after this unix time (seconds).

outputs.name: records
outputs.type: List[{ run: String, instance?: String, node: String, service: String, model?: String, amountUsd: Number | Null, paidBy: String, atUnix: Number }]
outputs.description: One entry per priced call: `{ run, instance, node, service, model?, amountUsd, paidBy, atUnix }`. `amountUsd` is null when the service's price could not be measured.

outputs.name: totalUsd
outputs.description: Sum of every non-null `amountUsd`. Short of the real cost when `unpricedCalls` is above 0.

outputs.name: unpricedCalls
outputs.description: How many of `records` have a null `amountUsd`, so are missing from `totalUsd`. 0 means the total is complete.

then.message: InstanceCosts '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no node of this program. Name it the way the program writes it (`draft`, `work.draft` inside a group, or `one.draft` inside an included file).
